task.text: `InvoiceReminder` builds its own `InvoiceStore`, calls the `MailGateway` singleton and reads today's date, so no test can control it.
Inject what it needs. `Reminders.create()` is the composition root: it keeps its signature and behaviour, and it is the only place that picks implementations.

items: `interface Mailer` with `void send(String to, String body)`.

hints.text: Look at every noun the reminder gets for free: a store, a mail gateway, the date. Each is a dependency hidden inside the class. Turn each into something the constructor receives.
